summary: Iter 132 — Verified read-only checker script scripts/cek_rekening_pencairan.py and quick API regression on GET /api/marketing/withdrawals/bank-options. Both fully pass; script matches API 1:1 (20 rekening).

test_results.1_script_from_app_cwd: PASS — `cd /app && python scripts/cek_rekening_pencairan.py` exit=0, prints 'TERBACA di pemilih rekening: 20' with 20 rows (1-1101, 1-1102, 1-1201, 1-1202, 1-1211..1-1215, 1-1219, 1-1221..1-1225, 1-1251..1-1255) and 'Rekening pencairan per toko' with 7 stores each ✓ (all 1-1201).
test_results.2_script_from_other_cwd_env_only: PASS — with backend/.env temporarily renamed and MONGO_URL/DB_NAME exported, `cd / && python /app/scripts/cek_rekening_pencairan.py` produces identical output and exit=0. Confirms docker-container scenario (no .env file, only env vars) works. Script's load_dotenv is a no-op when the file is absent and os.environ is used directly.
test_results.3_read_only_verification: PASS — collection counts before and after running the script twice: rahaza_cash_accounts=20 (unchanged), rahaza_coa_accounts=228 (unchanged), marketing_platform_accounts=7 (unchanged). Script only performs .find() reads; no writes in code.
test_results.4_api_regression_bank_options: PASS — GET /api/marketing/withdrawals/bank-options (admin token) returns {ok:true, data:[...20 items]} with identical codes to the script output: 1-1101, 1-1102, 1-1201, 1-1202, 1-1211-1215, 1-1219, 1-1221-1225, 1-1251-1255. Count matches script's 'TERBACA: 20'.

critical_code_review_comments: scripts/cek_rekening_pencairan.py is safely read-only (only .find() on 3 collections + call to bank_options which is also read-only).

Script correctly handles both cases: (a) local dev with backend/.env present, (b) docker container with only env vars — because load_dotenv on a missing path silently no-ops and MONGO_URL/DB_NAME are read via os.environ[].
Docstring correctly documents the docker invocation: `docker compose --env-file .env exec -T backend python /app/scripts/cek_rekening_pencairan.py`.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Script scripts/cek_rekening_pencairan.py is the canonical read-only checker for the Finance payout-bank picker; it mirrors GET /api/marketing/withdrawals/bank-options exactly (20 codes in this seed). Full feature regression already covered in /app/backend/tests/test_iter131_finance_payout_banks.py.
